items.claim: List keyboard/hover/press rows held as indexes, so they drift when `setRows` inserts or reorders
List label drawn with no width limit
Button label drawn with no width limit
List with a `height` shorter than its rows draws rows past its bounds where no press reaches them
items.note: Rows are now clipped to the bounds, the wheel scrolls them (claimed only while there is something to scroll), and the keyboard's row is scrolled into view. This adds `ListWidget.scrollTop` and `HudListState.scrollTop`, so its changeset is `minor`.

items.claim: Button presses on Space keydown and on every auto-repeat
items.note: Space now presses once on keyup, a Space keyup is ignored if focus left after its keydown, and Enter still presses on keydown.
